outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 25–74, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its side and interior (frames 90–118, image and left_ego_image). The gripper withdraws and the drawer remains visibly open through frame 146 (left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed attempt, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
